evidence.rev: YLPTEC K78xx-2000R3 Series (English, the datasheet LCSC links for C18212380)
evidence.method: agent read BOTH datasheets and viewed the page images: YLPTEC p5 'Pin-Out' table (pin 1 Vin, 2 GND, 3 +Vo for positive output; 3 Vin/-Vo/GND for negative) and the identical table on the ORIGINAL Mornsun K78xx-2000R3 datasheet (https://www.mornsun.cn/public/uploads/pdf/K78xx-2000R3.pdf, 2023.06.25-A/8, p5, 引脚方式: 1 Vin, 2 GND, 3 +Vo). Typical-circuit figure p4 of both shows +Vin on pin 1, GND on pin 2, +Vout on pin 3. Selection table p1: K7805-2000R3 = 5 V, 2000 mA, Vin 8-36 V (24 V nominal), efficiency 92/89 %, -40..+85 C. Recommended layout p5: grid 2.54 mm, hole dia 1.20 mm.
evidence.notes: Agent read, a person has not. KiCad Converter_DCDC:R-785.0-1.0 (1 IN, 2 GND, 3 OUT) AGREES with the datasheet pin table; KiCad footprint pads 1,2,3 at 2.54 mm pitch, drill 1.20 mm = datasheet layout hole 1.20 mm. Datasheet says 'Pin compatible with LM78xx' (1 IN, 2 GND, 3 OUT is also the LM7805 TO-220 order). NOT in the datasheets: any absolute-maximum input voltage (only the recommended 8-36 V range and 'for Vin > 30 V add a 22uF/50V input cap'), so abs_max is left empty. 'Reverse Polarity at Input: Avoid / Not protected': a reversed supply destroys it. lead_mm is ILLUSTRATIVE: read from the dimension drawing (0.70 x 0.30 mm, terminal cross-section tolerance +-0.10 mm, so max 0.80 x 0.40 used); which of the 0.70/0.30 labels is width vs thickness comes from a low-resolution drawing. Provenance: the LCSC listing C18212380 is manufactured by YLPTEC (Zhongshan Yichuan); the K7805-2000R3 name is Mornsun's original product (other LCSC listings of the same MPN exist, e.g. C2931187 DEXU). The two datasheets agree on the pin table, but a clone's real pinout is only proven by the part in hand: check the module marking before powering.

vin.cond: K7805-2000R3 positive output: nominal 24 V, range 8-36 V; above 30 V an external 22 uF/50 V input capacitor is required (table note)

vout.cond: 5 V +-3 % max (typ +-2 %), full load, over the input range (output voltage accuracy row, 'other' outputs)

iq_ma.cond: no-load input current, nominal input voltage (other outputs row)

efficiency_pct.cond: full load: typ 92 % at min Vin, 89 % at max Vin (the 'min' here is the max-Vin figure)

regulator.note: reverse input voltage is NOT protected ('prohibited', p2); output short-circuit protection is continuous, self-recovering (p2). Not a linear regulator: input current is about Pout/eff, not Iout

gaps: no absolute-maximum input voltage stated (only the 8-36 V range and the 30 V capacitor note)
theta_JA / junction temperature not stated: the module has only a power-vs-ambient derating curve (p3, graph only, not extracted)
